detail.longDescription:
Meet Chat AI 5: AI Agent & Video, one app for chat, voice, images and video. Talk to top AI models such as GPT-6.1 Sol, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Gemini 4 Argon, Grok 4.7, DeepSeek and Nano Banana, and switch between them anytime.

VOICE CHAT
Talk to AI in real time, hands-free. Ask questions, think out loud, or share your camera and ask about what you see.

AI IMAGE GENERATOR
Describe an idea and get stunning images: art, product shots, interior concepts and more. Turn a rough sketch into a finished picture with Sketch to Image.

AI VIDEO GENERATOR
Bring your ideas to life in motion. Describe a scene or start from a photo, and get high-quality short videos in seconds.

DEEP SEARCH
Get up-to-date, detailed answers. Deep Search searches the web and reads the pages for you, and shows the sources it used.

CHOOSE YOUR MODEL, OR LET AUTO DECIDE
Pick the model you like for each chat, or leave it on Auto.

AI WRITING ASSISTANT
- Draft emails, posts and marketing copy in seconds.
- Brainstorm ideas for any project.
- Polish your grammar and style.

CHAT WITH YOUR DOCUMENTS
Upload a PDF or document, then ask questions about it, get a summary, or translate it.

ONE SUBSCRIPTION FOR IPHONE AND THE WEB
Use the same account and plan on iPhone and on the web.

FULL ACCESS TO ALL FEATURES
Chat AI 5 is free to download. Full access to all features, including AI image and video generation, Voice Chat, Deep Search, chat with your documents and the most advanced AI models, requires a subscription or a one-time purchase. Usage quotas apply. Manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple Account settings.

Chat AI 5 is an independent app and is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, xAI or DeepSeek. Model names are trademarks of their respective owners.
